karma: Every defect in the Aasha-AIOS repository: issues, bugs, breaks, chokes
karana: project toolchains: npm exec -- (Node), go test ./... (Go), python -m pytest (Python)
aasha-prompt-compiler evidence classes and verification gate
git working tree (reversible local edits only)
sampradana: Aasha Foundation maintainers and the K-12 students served by the delivered child HTML5 bundles
apadana: NEVER auto-mutate before producing the proposal and receiving explicit human approval
NEVER mark a fix as done without a real analyzer or test run reporting it
NEVER claim absence from an empty search result
NEVER invent a file path or line number not returned by a tool
NEVER force-push, reset --hard, amend published commits, or delete branches
NEVER apply the 20 MB ceiling outside CHILD_HTML5_BUNDLE scope
NEVER delete required educational functionality merely to satisfy a size gate
NEVER re-download an identical open-source resource already present locally
NEVER treat SKILL as SYSTEM: this run changes no architecture or build plan
NEVER fold max_tokens, daily budget, diff budget, or payload budget into the 20 MB rule
adhikarana: Local checkout, offline-capable, Node 24 + Go + Python present

invariants.skill_not_system: This is a pluggable execution skill. Zero changes to build plan, core runtime, or architecture. Output is proposals plus isolated fixes.
invariants.kid_own_book_first: All pedagogical content derives from the child's prescribed textbook as authoritative source of truth.
invariants.refine_not_reinvent: Multi-turn repair increases precision without intent drift or mutated architectural constraints.
invariants.read_evaluate_first: Read, then evaluate, then propose, then await approval. No exceptions.
invariants.resource_first_reuse: EXACT_REUSE -> PARAMETRIC_ADAPT -> COMPOSE -> LOCAL_ADAPTATION -> CERTIFIED_GENERATION -> SAFE_FALLBACK. Code generation is a LAST RESORT.
invariants.local_first_precedence: LOCAL RESOURCE > LOCAL REGISTRY > LOCAL VOCABULARY > LOCAL EXPERIENCE > LOCAL AST/GRAPH > EXISTING CACHE > REMOTE MODEL. Never invoke an LLM to recreate information already available locally.

twenty_mb_scope_lock.applies_only_to: child-facing standalone offline HTML5 learning bundle
twenty_mb_scope_lock.note: Resource libraries may exceed 20 MB. The compiler bundles only selected, deduplicated assets per chapter.
twenty_mb_scope_lock.on_violation: CERTIFICATION = FAIL, RELEASE = BLOCKED. Prefer deterministic optimization (resource selection, deduplication, font subsetting, asset compression, dead-code elimination) before removing functionality.

instruction: Perform a complete defect sweep of this repository and produce a single machine-applicable repair plan, then apply it only after approval. For every defect found, supply the root cause, the minimal fix, the exact file and line, and the command that proves the fix.

pipeline.name: Observe
pipeline.action: Enumerate the real tree with list_directory. Read manifests (package.json, pyproject.toml, go.mod). Record every declared entry point and every declared script. Do not guess paths.

pipeline.name: Understand
pipeline.action: For each subsystem, identify its entry point and trace the flow to its outputs using call linkage before reading bodies.

pipeline.name: Decompose
pipeline.action: Map every discovered defect into the six Kāraka roles so ownership (karta), target (karma), tool (karana), and constraint (apadana) are explicit.

pipeline.name: Classify Evidence
pipeline.action: Tag every claim FACT / STRONG_INFERENCE / SAFE_DEFAULT / ASSUMPTION / UNKNOWN / CONFLICT. A defect is only FACT when a tool this run showed it.

pipeline.name: Gap and Conflict Resolution
pipeline.action: Where a manifest and its code disagree (scaffold drift), record both sides and flag CONFLICT. Where a path is referenced but missing, record UNKNOWN and verify with a listing before reporting.

pipeline.name: Harden Invariants
pipeline.action: Attach the invariants block to every fix. Reject any fix that violates an apadana entry.

pipeline.name: Mode Select
pipeline.action: For each defect choose REPAIR (clear fix), CLARIFY (ambiguous), or BLOCK (unsafe or architectural).

pipeline.name: Compute Delta
pipeline.action: Emit ADDED / REMOVED / CHANGED / PRESERVED / SUPERSEDED per defect.

pipeline.name: Compile Targets
pipeline.action: Produce the ordered repair_plan and the teacher-facing summary.

pipeline.name: Verify
pipeline.action: Verdict PASS / REPAIR / CLARIFY / BLOCK with a confidence score in 0.0 to 1.0.

defect_classes.name: Broken entry point
defect_classes.detect: Declared script or binary that fails to resolve or start
defect_classes.prove_with: run the declared command and capture the error

defect_classes.name: Stub presented as working
defect_classes.detect: Command or handler that prints success without performing the work
defect_classes.prove_with: read the body and show no side effect occurs

defect_classes.name: Missing path or import
defect_classes.detect: Referenced file, module, or workspace absent from disk
defect_classes.prove_with: list_directory on the parent, not an empty search

defect_classes.name: Manifest-code drift
defect_classes.detect: Documented scripts or deps disagree with the actual manifest

defect_classes.name: Unverified dependency
defect_classes.detect: Code that requires an absent key, venv, binary, or backend
defect_classes.prove_with: read the guard and confirm the precondition

defect_classes.name: Hardcoded environment path
defect_classes.detect: Absolute or machine-specific path that throws off this machine
defect_classes.prove_with: read the literal and test resolution

defect_classes.name: Invariant violation
defect_classes.detect: Code or content breaching a declared invariant
defect_classes.prove_with: cite the invariant and the offending line

defect_classes.name: Size-gate misapplication
defect_classes.detect: The 20 MB child-bundle ceiling applied outside its scope
defect_classes.prove_with: show the target is not CHILD_HTML5_BUNDLE and is on the exclusion list

defect_classes.name: Redundant regeneration
defect_classes.detect: Re-downloading, re-deriving, or re-generating something locally available
defect_classes.prove_with: point to the local registry, cache, or dictionary entry

defect_classes.name: Failing or absent test
defect_classes.detect: Test suite missing, uncollectable, or failing
defect_classes.prove_with: run the suite and quote the executed-and-passed counts

repair_plan_schema.karana: tool or method used for the fix
repair_plan_schema.apadana: invariants the fix must not breach
repair_plan_schema.evidence_class: FACT | STRONG_INFERENCE | SAFE_DEFAULT | ASSUMPTION | UNKNOWN | CONFLICT
repair_plan_schema.root_cause: <why it happens, not what the name suggests>
repair_plan_schema.fix_kind: READ_AND_EVALUATE | LOCAL_REUSE | EXACT_REUSE | PARAMETRIC_ADAPT | COMPOSE | CERTIFIED_GENERATION | SAFE_FALLBACK
repair_plan_schema.blast_radius: <callers and dependents that must be re-verified>

verification_audit.note: A fix counts as verified only when a tool this run reported it. Exit code 0 alone is not evidence.

execution_protocol.phase_1: Sweep and report. Emit the single JSON document. Apply nothing.
execution_protocol.phase_2: Await explicit human approval of the repair_plan. Approval is bound to the exact plan hash and never carries across revisions.
execution_protocol.phase_3: Apply approved repairs in dependency order, smallest reversible patch first.
execution_protocol.phase_4: After each patch, run its verify command and record the actual output, not an expectation.
execution_protocol.phase_5: On repeated failure, quarantine that repair and continue. Never retry an identical action expecting a different result.

forbidden_shortcuts: Deleting tests or checks to make a suite pass
Removing functionality to satisfy a size gate
Marking a defect fixed without a real verifying run
Broad refactors framed as bug fixes
Silent dependency upgrades outside the request
Rewriting a file wholesale when a targeted patch suffices
final_line: Do not mutate this repository. Produce the JSON, stop, and wait for approval.
